# appsignal_notifier (Data Source)

A notifier of an app, looked up by name. The AppSignal API cannot create notifiers; make them in the AppSignal UI and refer to them here.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Notifiers can only be created in the AppSignal UI; look them up by name.
data "appsignal_notifier" "slack" {
  app_id = data.appsignal_app.web.id
  name   = "Slack #alerts"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app_id` (String)
- `name` (String)

### Read-Only

- `icon` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
